title: Practice 19: Than: чем, or the genitive

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Which fits? *Николай Гоголь, «Вечера на хуторе близ Диканьки»*
exercises.ru: Вам век не увидать богаче ___!
exercises.why: «An adjective in the comparative degree may be followed by the object of comparison in the Genitive case, or by a phrase consisting of "чем" plus the object of comparison in the Nominative case.» — DLI, Lesson 80. From Николай Гоголь, «Вечера на хуторе близ Диканьки».
